title: U-toggle re-arm can pass the freshness check over a freed shifts buffer
location: app/main.odin: update_preview freshness check, disarm_preview, U handler
detail: Disarm frees shifts but leaves preview_pipe/preview_to_tier stale; re-arm forces preview_gen=0. If topology.gen==0 (fresh fixture-seeded run), the check passes and the panel slices deleted memory.
recommended_fix: disarm_preview should also clear preview_pipe/preview_to_tier and set preview_gen to an impossible sentinel; the arm path should clear preview_pipe too.

title: forecast_preview.dem header documents a 1300ms capture the body never defines
location: demos/forecast_preview.dem: header comment vs capture directives
evidence:
+#   1300ms — preview 1 -> wide:  "2 routes reroute to node 2" +
+#            "attracts 1 route" (the magnet) — the REROUTE card, plural +
+#            magnet branches; weather shows the surge countdown.
+at 29500ms preview 1 wide
+capture at 30000ms
+at 30500ms preview 1 standard
detail: Header describes a 1300ms capture (with surge countdown); the body's first capture is 30000ms — goldens are 30000/31000/32000/33000ms. The documented 1300ms frame is never pinned.
recommended_fix: Fix the header bullet to 30000ms (or add the missing 1300ms capture) so the documentation matches the directives and goldens.

title: Merge card header text names the wrong consolidate target (node 1 instead of node 5)
evidence:
+#            -> "attracts 2 routes" + "2 routes consolidate on node 1" +
+#            "2 routes consolidate on node 4" — the MERGE card (the mid-router
+at 32500ms preview 4 wide
+at 500ms draw 4 5 standard
+spawn_node residential 32 15
+spawn_node router_basic 40 11
detail: Preview 4 wide upgrades res2→r1 (nodes 4→5). The (res2,host2)/(host2,res2) pairs consolidate on r1 = node 5, not node 1 (diamond-1's m1). Header mislabels the pinned text.
recommended_fix: Correct the header bullet to '2 routes consolidate on node 5'.

title: parse_demo's unknown-at-verb error message omits the new 'preview' verb
evidence:
+// `at <n>ms preview <pipe> <tier>` (Job C / R4 — render-only),
+			case:
+				return {}, fmt.tprintf("unknown at-verb %q (want draw|spawn|demolish|place|emphasis|lane): %s", fields[2], line)
detail: The comment list was updated to include preview, but the error message's want-list was missed — a parse failure now hints a verb set that omits preview.
recommended_fix: Add preview to the error message's want-list.

title: PR body claims 10 new pins; the test file defines 9 @(test) procs
detail: forecast_shift_test.odin adds nine @(test) procs (split, reroute, merge, honest-pin, purity, errors, attract-parallel, summarize/next-tier, same-cost) — one fewer than the PR's claim.
recommended_fix: Correct the pin count in the PR body or add the missing tenth test.
